$comment: Real jobs: tasks a person does with this app, each with an outcome a check can observe. Keyed by job id so scripts/merge-json merges two PRs that add different jobs. scripts/jobs check validates every field; jobs.md beside this file is generated from it on dev (scripts/jobs render), never edited. The fields and the done rule: docs/factory/packets.md, Jobs.

RJ-D01.job: Make an Instagram post: a 1080×1350 frame from a preset, a placed photo, a title, then export PNG.
RJ-D01.outcome: Output is exactly 1080×1350 and the photo is not squashed.
RJ-D01.needs_note: S10 frame presets, S20 placed images, S11
RJ-D01.trap: Export at 2x gives 2160 px; image stretched to the frame

RJ-D02.job: Export an app icon frame at 1x, 2x and 3x PNG with suffixes.
RJ-D02.outcome: Three files, right sizes, crisp edges, nothing overwritten.

RJ-D03.job: Make a button component with an instance in three places; change the master colour.
RJ-D03.trap: Override text reset by the master edit

RJ-D04.job: Align five icons to a row and distribute them evenly.
RJ-D04.outcome: Gaps are equal to the point.

RJ-D05.job: Drag a card to the frame centre.
RJ-D05.outcome: It snaps and a guide shows the distance.

RJ-D06.job: Draw a logo with the pen (curves, close the path), then move one point.
RJ-D06.outcome: The saved path has one closed contour of exactly four anchors; the moved anchor and its handles moved by the same offset and the others are unchanged.
RJ-D06.trap: Closing the path adds a duplicate point

RJ-D07.job: Subtract a circle from a square to make a crescent icon; move the circle later.
RJ-D07.trap: Boolean bakes to a flat path

RJ-D08.outcome: It opens identically in a browser and in other tools: viewBox set, no raster, text as outlines when asked.
RJ-D08.trap: Width/height 100%, no viewBox, live text with a missing font

RJ-D09.job: Export a page as a print PDF.
RJ-D09.outcome: Text stays selectable and fonts are embedded.
RJ-D09.trap: Fonts not embedded; PDF fails in other apps

RJ-D10.job: Copy a shape as SVG and paste it into a code editor.
RJ-D10.outcome: Valid SVG with the same colours.
RJ-D10.needs_note: A1 copy as SVG or CSS

RJ-D11.job: Type a heading into a fixed-width box.
RJ-D11.outcome: It wraps, the box grows to fit, line height can be set.
RJ-D11.trap: Text overflows the box with no sign

RJ-D12.job: Place a photo inside a rounded frame and move it inside the crop.
RJ-D12.needs_note: S20 placed images; design/placed-images wires them into Design (pictures in frames by cover)

RJ-D13.job: Give a background a two-stop linear gradient and rotate its angle.
RJ-D13.needs_note: S24 gradient fills; design/gradient-fill wires them into Design

RJ-D14.job: Add a drop shadow to a card; change it later.
RJ-D14.outcome: The SVG export holds the shadow as a filter with the edited values, referenced by the card; the PNG and PDF half is RJ-D43 (macOS).
RJ-D14.trap: SVG export drops the shadow silently

RJ-D15.job: Rotate a layer 15° with the handles.

RJ-D16.job: Option-drag to copy a card three times into a grid.

RJ-D17.job: Group three layers, rename the group, drag it above another in the Layers panel.
RJ-D17.outcome: The group holds the three layers under its new name and sits above the other layer in the Layers panel and on the canvas.

RJ-D18.job: Copy layers from one file and paste into another.
RJ-D18.trap: Fonts or radius dropped in paste

RJ-D19.outcome: Content is identical after reopen; undo works in the session.
RJ-D19.trap: Reopened file differs by a rounding step

RJ-D20.trap: Work lost (only saved files survive today)

RJ-D21.job: Edit a saved file and try to close.
RJ-D21.outcome: A dot shows unsaved changes and close asks first.

RJ-D22.job: Make three pages and export each as PNG.
RJ-D22.outcome: One file per page, right sizes.

RJ-D23.job: Pick a colour from a placed photo with the eyedropper.
RJ-D23.outcome: The picked swatch equals the document pixel under the cursor, not the screen-scaled colour.
RJ-D23.needs_note: S13 and design/eyedropper pick the colour; S20 adds the placed photo it is picked from

RJ-D24.job: Set stroke, radius and opacity on five selected layers that differ.
RJ-D24.outcome: Inspector shows Mixed and one edit applies to all.
RJ-D24.trap: Edit applies only to the first layer

RJ-D25.job: Open a file whose font this Mac lacks.
RJ-D25.outcome: A notice names the font and the substitute; layout is unchanged until the person chooses.
RJ-D25.trap: Silent fallback reflows every text box

RJ-D26.job: Paste or open an SVG from another design app.
RJ-D26.outcome: It arrives as editable vectors with colours kept.
RJ-D26.trap: Black fills; objects collapse to 1 px (100% sizes)

RJ-D27.job: Define colour variables with light and dark modes and switch the mode.

RJ-D28.job: Resize a phone frame to tablet width.
RJ-D28.outcome: Pinned elements stay pinned, stretched ones stretch.
RJ-D28.needs_note: none: constraints are v1 Out and not in the beta-80 plan

RJ-D29.job: Export a 1 px hairline icon at 1x.
RJ-D29.outcome: Lines are crisp, not two grey pixels.

RJ-D30.outcome: Opens in under 2 s, zoom and pan stay smooth.

RJ-D31.job: Zoom to the selection, fit the page, read positions on the rulers.
RJ-D31.outcome: The view frames the selection's rotated bounds, the page fits the window, and the ruler positions match the inspector.
RJ-D31.trap: Zoom to selection ignores rotated layers

RJ-D32.job: Resize the page to a new device size, then find a layer that now sits off it.
RJ-D32.outcome: Width and Height each change in one undo step; layers off the page stay visible, dimmed.
RJ-D32.needs_note: canvas-basics CB-c (page size in the inspector, layers past the edge)
RJ-D32.trap: Page size fixed at creation; off-page layers vanish

RJ-D33.job: Nudge a card 30 times, jump back 10 steps in History, save and reopen.
RJ-D33.outcome: The reopened card sits where the 20th nudge left it (20 points right).
RJ-D33.trap: The jump records a step, or the save writes the state before the jump

RJ-D34.job: Pick a red ellipse's colour with the eyedropper onto a white rectangle under it, and save.
RJ-D34.outcome: The point over both reads red, and the saved rectangle's fill is #FF0000.
RJ-D34.trap: The sample reads the selected rectangle instead of the ellipse on top

RJ-D35.job: Draw a five-point star badge with the Shape tool, save, reopen and export SVG.
RJ-D35.outcome: The reopened layer is still a star with its points and ratio, and the SVG path has ten vertices with the first at the top centre.
RJ-D35.trap: The star reopens as a rectangle, or the SVG writes its box

RJ-D36.job: Give a rectangle a 2 pt dashed border with round caps and export SVG.
RJ-D36.outcome: The SVG rect has stroke-dasharray "8 4" and stroke-linecap "round".
RJ-D36.trap: The SVG drops the dash or writes it unscaled

RJ-D41.job: Export a 540x675 pt frame as JPEG at exactly 1080x1350, and as PNG at a 512 px long edge.
RJ-D41.outcome: The JPEG is exactly 1080x1350 with its transparent corner on the frame's fill; the PNG is 410x512 with alpha.
RJ-D41.trap: 2x applied on top (2160x2700), or the JPEG's transparent corner comes out black

RJ-D42.job: Save two Design files, then reopen one from File > Open Recent; drop a Halo project on Design.
RJ-D42.outcome: Open Recent lists only the two Design files, newest first; the Halo project is handed to Halo and the Design document is unchanged.
RJ-D42.trap: Design has no Open Recent, or it lists every app's files

RJ-D50.job: Set a three-line justified paragraph in Design with line height 1.5, letter spacing 20 and italic, then export a PNG.
RJ-D50.outcome: The first two lines' ink spans the box width within 2 px and the last line doesn't; the baseline gap is 1.5 times ascent plus descent within 1 px.
RJ-D50.trap: Line height or justify is set in the inspector but the export ignores it

RJ-D43.job: Export a card with a drop shadow as a 2x PNG and as a PDF.
RJ-D43.outcome: The PNG has shadow pixels past the card's edge by the style's reach at 2x; the PDF holds the card as a vector path with the shadow as one image under it.
RJ-D43.trap: The shadow is cut at the card's bounds, or the PDF rasterizes the card itself
